intro.title: A landscape that
intro.para1: Franciacorta is one of Italy's most charming wine regions: a stretch of rolling hills between Brescia and Lake Iseo, covered in vineyards and crisscrossed by romantic roads that connect medieval villages and Benedictine abbeys.
intro.para2: The name immediately brings to mind the bubbles of Franciacorta DOCG—the only Italian sparkling wine produced exclusively using the Metodo Classico—but the region offers much more: nature, history, art, and world-class food and wine.
intro.para3: Ome, the town where San Michele is located, is one of the most picturesque villages in the hills: a panoramic setting, vineyards overlooking the houses, and tranquility and beauty around every corner.

wine.title: The
wine.para1: Like Champagne in France, Franciacorta is the quintessential Italian Metodo Classico. Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Pinot Blanc are crafted in the cellar with meticulous care to produce elegant, long-lasting sparkling wines of extraordinary complexity.
wine.para2: Upon request, we organize winery tours and tastings
